items.control_name: Prohibit Unrestricted SSH (22) and RDP (3389) in Security Groups
items.description: Security groups must not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to ports 22 or 3389.
items.recommended_value: No security groups allow 0.0.0.0/0 on SSH/RDP
items.remediation_notes: Revoke 0.0.0.0/0 ingress rule on 'sg-01a2b3c' and use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.

items.control_name: Attach AWS WAFv2 Web ACL to CloudFront & ALB Endpoints
items.description: Public CloudFront distributions and Application Load Balancers must be protected by AWS WAFv2 with managed rules.
items.recommended_value: WAFv2 Web ACL attached to 100% of public endpoints
items.remediation_notes: Regularly test WAF rules against OWASP Top 10 automated scanners.

items.control_name: Enable VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch / S3
items.description: VPC Flow Logs must be enabled for all VPCs to capture IP traffic to/from network interfaces.
items.current_value: Enabled on 5 of 6 VPCs; missing on 'vpc-legacy-test'
items.recommended_value: 100% VPC Flow Log enablement with 10-minute max aggregation interval
items.remediation_notes: Create flow log destination to S3 security archive bucket for 'vpc-legacy-test'.

items.control_name: Enforce Default Deny on VPC Network Access Control Lists (NACLs)
items.description: Custom NACLs must be configured to block known malicious IP blocks and prevent asymmetric routing bypass.
items.current_value: Default allow-all NACLs in use across VPCs
items.recommended_value: Hardened subnet NACLs with explicit deny rules for high-risk ports
items.remediation_notes: Review subnet boundaries and implement defense-in-depth NACL rules.
